entity.summary: Non-custodial Cardano wallet ecosystem designed for user-controlled private keys across mobile and browser surfaces.
entity.notes: Current first-party VESPR documentation explicitly says VESPR is non-custodial and does not collect or store recovery phrases or private keys. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: VESPR non-custodial Cardano mobile wallet for iOS and Android.
products.notes: Selected mobile runtime only; browser wallet support listed by VESPR is deferred.

events.title: VESPR Wallet 4.1.0 released
events.description: VESPR Wallet version 4.1.0 was released on 2026-07-27 with a refreshed interface plus bug fixes and performance improvements, providing a dated lifecycle event for VESPR Mobile.

events.title: Keystone published VESPR hardware-wallet integration guidance
events.description: Keystone published an official VESPR integration guide documenting connection and transaction-signing support between Keystone 3 Pro and VESPR Mobile, with VESPR app version 3.8.0 identified as the required wallet version in the guide.

evidence.title: What is VESPR?
evidence.notes: Current first-party VESPR documentation explicitly calls VESPR non-custodial and says users maintain control and ownership of Cardano private keys/assets.

evidence.title: Download VESPR
evidence.notes: First-party download documentation lists official iOS, Android and browser versions; mobile is selected for this breadth pass.

evidence.title: VESPR Wallet official GitHub organization
evidence.notes: Official VESPR GitHub organization identifies VESPR as a non-custodial Cardano wallet available on iOS, Android, and browser extension platforms. This supports current product existence but not an original launch date.

evidence.title: VESPR: Cardano Wallet - Version History
evidence.notes: App Store version history identifies VESPR 4.1.0 on 2026-07-27; candidate app_store_listing normalized to canonical database_reference.

evidence.title: VESPR (Mobile)
evidence.notes: Official Keystone integration guide published 2026-09-01 documents VESPR Mobile connection and signing with Keystone 3 Pro and identifies VESPR app version 3.8.0 for the integration.
